sections.body: Puberty is when your body starts changing from a child's body into an adult's. It usually starts somewhere between about 8 and 14. Everyone's timing is different, and that's normal.
Common changes for everyone: growth spurts, new body hair, more sweat (time for deodorant and daily washing), spots, and stronger feelings or mood changes.
Many girls develop breasts and start having periods. Many boys' voices get deeper and their shoulders get broader.
Questions are normal! Ask a parent, school nurse or another trusted adult. Reliable health websites can help too.

quiz.q: During puberty you sweat more. What helps?
options: Wearing the same clothes all week
hints: After football you shower and change clothes. Daily, during puberty, it's similar.
quiz.explain: Washing every day, wearing clean clothes and using deodorant helps.
